description:
One Complete or Frame Per Customer!

Due to the limited stock, we are only offering one bike or frame pr customer, any orders with more than one bike will be cancelled without notice.

Due to high demand completes will start shipping after June 10th.

A one-off OMNIUM cargo created in collaboration with Cinelli, featuring a custom paint scheme inspired by the legendary Cinelli Laser. The graphic design pays tribute to the bold aesthetic of one of cycling’s most iconic track bikes. Built f rom a unique combination of Columbus and OMNIUM tubing, the frame blends classic Italian steel heritage with modern cargo functionality. A meeting point between utility, craftsmanship and racing design.

Limited to only 120 frames and they are available as either completes or frame kits.

Built with a mix of Columbus and Omnium tubing, the frame carries the precision craftsmanship and ride quality that made Columbus a defining part of Italian racing history. Responsive, smooth, and dependable, it gives the bike a lively feel without losing the practicality Omnium bikes are known for.

The silver cockpit and Cinelli saddle are subtle homages to classic Cinelli builds and the era of the Laser. Clean aluminium finishes and timeless shapes give the bike a distinct character, connecting modern utility riding with the visual language of iconic Italian bikes.

Created specifically for the Supercargo we are Introducing the Omnium Neo Retro Crank Set, a classily styled square taper crank set with a with a narrow-wide tooth profile for 1x drivetrains.

Apex is SRAM’s dedicated gravel groupset, a 1×11 groupset with wide range and is simple to use. With a long cage that fits a 42-tooth cassette and the X-HORIZON design reduces shifting force adding extra comfort. It also comes with Sram CAGE LOCK making wheel removal and maintenance much easier.
